$comment: T-414: single machine-readable SoT for the prdt hook roster. install.sh §4 (jq --slurpfile) and packages/gui/electron/ipc/onboarding.ts (installPrdtHooks) both derive their ~/.claude/settings.json `hooks` registration from THIS file — neither hand-writes the event/matcher/order shape anymore. Edit here, not in either derived site. `basenames` is the flat roster (order = install.sh §1 mirror-copy order); `registrations` is the ordered list of {event, matcher?, hooks[]} entries each derivation reduces over, in registration order. `hooks[]` entries are basenames from ~/.prdt/hooks/ — install.sh prefixes `$PRDT_HOME/hooks/`, onboarding.ts prefixes the equivalent `<homeDir>/.prdt/hooks/`, both quoting the final command string.
